meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing with a hybrid engine strategy: resident-kernel engines first - DuckDB plus a resident Python stack (Polars/numpy/matplotlib) in persistent js/py eval kernels where the harness has them, bun/uv one-shots elsewhere - and per-action placement judgment (in-memory vs streaming vs remote-in-place). Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,自动完成统计、聚合与可视化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理CSV/JSON等数据文件并需要快速洞察
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files to produce statistics, aggregations, and charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often process CSV/JSON files and need fast data insights

howto.what: 装上后，遇到数据文件时，Claude会先判断采用内存、流式还是远程查询方式，再用DuckDB/Polars/numpy直接分析CSV、Parquet、JSON等文件，给出答案及行数/耗时，必要时生成图表。
howto.when: 当你说“分析这些数据”、“这个CSV里有什么”、“按列分组”等，或要求对数据做筛选、合并、画图等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析 sales.csv 的月销售额趋势。
用SQL查询这个parquet文件，按城市分组求平均。
say.note: 触发DuckDB就地查询，不整载入内存。

say.text: 这个数据集比可用内存还大，帮我流式统计每一列的最大值。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude analyzes data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON) via DuckDB/Polars/numpy: it picks in-memory vs streaming vs remote, then answers with row counts/timing, charts on request.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you say "analyze the data", "what is in this CSV/parquet/json", "group by", or ask for filtering, merging, or plotting, etc.

say_en.text: Can you analyze monthly sales trends in sales.csv?
say_en.note: Aggregates with DuckDB and plots a trend.

say_en.text: Use SQL to query this parquet file, group by city and average.
say_en.note: Queries in place via DuckDB, no full load.

say_en.text: This dataset is larger than RAM; stream and compute per-column max.
say_en.note: Uses Polars streaming to avoid swapping.
